coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Seven of nine ground-truth variable items are represented: the required LLaMA-2 models, weight precisions, four methods, WikiText-2 evaluation at sequence length 2048, an unquantized FP16 baseline, perplexity, and Inf/NaN stability checks. This gives 78% coverage, although several required settings are expanded rather than held fixed.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The design does not consistently fix inputs and KV caches to FP16: BF16 is allowed and KV-cache precision is unspecified. It also varies symmetric/asymmetric quantization and grouping instead of fixing per-column asymmetric quantization. Additional models, datasets, methods, and metrics broaden the experiment beyond the specified controlled design.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion or results were supplied, including the low-bit improvements from QuaRot-GPTQ, RTN failures, partial stabilization of RTN, or the 70B W2 perplexity reduction from 25.30 to 5.60.
